56	function parseArgs(values) {

65	    if (equals !== -1) {

8	const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));

29	    {
30	      target,
31	      signed: true,
32	      signature_kind: "Developer ID Application",
33	      notarized: true,
34	      artifacts: signedArtifacts,
35	      verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
36	    },
37	    null,
38	    2,
39	  )}\n`,

42	function signArchive(archive) {
43	  const temp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `deadreckon-sign-${target}-`));
44	  const extractDir = path.join(temp, "extract");
45	  fs.mkdirSync(extractDir);
46	  extractArchive(archive, extractDir);
47	  const binary = findBinary(extractDir);
48	  run("codesign", ["--sign", identity, "--options", "runtime", "--timestamp", binary]);
49	  run("codesign", ["--verify", "--verbose", binary]);
50	
51	  const notarizationZip = path.join(temp, `${target}-notarization.zip`);
52	  run("ditto", ["-c", "-k", "--keepParent", binary, notarizationZip]);
53	  run("xcrun", [
54	    "notarytool",
55	    "submit",
56	    notarizationZip,
57	    "--apple-id",
58	    required(process.env.APPLE_ID, "APPLE_ID"),
59	    "--team-id",
60	    required(process.env.APPLE_TEAM_ID, "APPLE_TEAM_ID"),
61	    "--password",
62	    required(process.env.APPLE_APP_PWD, "APPLE_APP_PWD"),
63	    "--wait",
64	    "--timeout",
65	    "30m",
66	  ]);
67	
68	  repackArchive(archive, extractDir);
69	}

71	function findArchives(root, targetTriple) {
72	  const matches = [];
73	  walk(root, (file) => {
74	    const normalized = file.replaceAll(path.sep, "/");
75	    if (
76	      normalized.includes(targetTriple) &&
77	      (file.endsWith(".tar.xz") || file.endsWith(".tar.gz") || file.endsWith(".tgz") || file.endsWith(".zip"))
78	    ) {

82	  return matches.sort();

109	    run("tar", ["-cJf", archive, "-C", sourceDir, ...entries]);
110	  } else {

112	  }

398	#[test]
399	fn release_manifest_covers_artifacts_and_checksums() {
400	    let temp = tempfile::TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
401	    let distrib = temp.path().join("target/distrib");
402	    fs::create_dir_all(&distrib).expect("distrib dir");
403	    // Real archives: verify-manifest fails closed on unreadable or
404	    // "./"-prefixed archives, so placeholder bytes are not valid fixtures.
405	    for stem in [
406	        "deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin",
407	        "deadreckon-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
408	    ] {
409	        let payload = temp.path().join("payload").join(stem);
410	        fs::create_dir_all(&payload).expect("payload");
411	        fs::write(payload.join("deadreckon"), stem).expect("binary");
412	        let output = Command::new("tar")
413	            .args([
414	                "-cJf",
415	                distrib
416	                    .join(format!("{stem}.tar.xz"))
417	                    .to_str()
418	                    .expect("utf8 path"),
419	                "-C",
420	                temp.path().join("payload").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
421	                stem,
422	            ])
423	            .output()
424	            .expect("tar");
425	        assert!(
426	            output.status.success(),
427	            "{}",
428	            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
429	        );
430	    }
431	    fs::create_dir_all(distrib.join("trust")).expect("trust dir");
432	    fs::write(
433	        distrib.join("trust/macos-aarch64-apple-darwin.json"),
434	        r#"{"target":"aarch64-apple-darwin","signed":true,"notarized":true}"#,
435	    )
436	    .expect("mac trust");
437	
438	    assert_release_trust_success([
439	        "sbom",
440	        "--dir",
441	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
442	        "--out",
443	        distrib
444	            .join("release.spdx.json")
445	            .to_str()
446	            .expect("utf8 path"),
447	    ]);
448	    assert_release_trust_success([
449	        "checksums",
450	        "--dir",
451	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
452	        "--out",
453	        distrib.join("SHA256SUMS").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
454	    ]);
455	    assert_release_trust_success([
456	        "manifest",
457	        "--dir",
458	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
459	        "--ref",
460	        "refs/tags/v1.2.3-rc.1",
461	        "--repo",
462	        "gregce/deadreckon",
463	        "--commit",
464	        "abc123",
465	        "--out",
466	        distrib
467	            .join("release-manifest.json")
468	            .to_str()
469	            .expect("utf8 path"),
470	    ]);
471	    assert_release_trust_success([
472	        "verify-manifest",
473	        "--dir",
474	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
475	        "--manifest",
476	        distrib
477	            .join("release-manifest.json")
478	            .to_str()
479	            .expect("utf8 path"),
480	        "--checksums",
481	        distrib.join("SHA256SUMS").to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
482	    ]);
483	
484	    let manifest = read_json(&distrib.join("release-manifest.json"));
485	    assert_eq!(
486	        Some(1),
487	        manifest.get("schema_version").and_then(JsonValue::as_u64)
488	    );
489	    assert_eq!(Some("rc"), manifest.get("lane").and_then(JsonValue::as_str));
490	    let artifacts = manifest
491	        .get("artifacts")
492	        .and_then(JsonValue::as_array)
493	        .expect("artifacts array");
494	    assert!(
495	        artifacts
496	            .iter()
497	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
498	                == Some("deadreckon-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz")
499	                && artifact.get("signed").and_then(JsonValue::as_bool) == Some(true)
500	                && artifact.get("notarized").and_then(JsonValue::as_bool) == Some(true)),
501	        "{manifest:#?}"
502	    );
503	    assert!(
504	        artifacts
505	            .iter()
506	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("SHA256SUMS")),
507	        "{manifest:#?}"
508	    );
509	    assert!(
510	        artifacts
511	            .iter()
512	            .any(|artifact| artifact.get("name").and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
513	                == Some("release.spdx.json")),
514	        "{manifest:#?}"
515	    );
516	}

772	#[test]
773	fn checksums_record_flat_basenames_and_collapse_nested_duplicates() {
774	    let temp = tempfile::TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
775	    let distrib = temp.path().join("target/distrib");
776	    fs::create_dir_all(distrib.join("target/distrib")).expect("nested dir");
777	    fs::write(distrib.join("deadreckon-installer.sh"), b"#!/bin/sh\n").expect("installer");
778	    // The CI global-artifact layout nests some files twice with identical
779	    // content; SHA256SUMS must record one flat basename per asset so users
780	    // can run `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` next to downloaded files.
781	    fs::write(
782	        distrib.join("target/distrib/deadreckon-installer.sh"),
783	        b"#!/bin/sh\n",
784	    )
785	    .expect("nested duplicate");
786	    let sums = distrib.join("SHA256SUMS");
787	
788	    assert_release_trust_success([
789	        "checksums",
790	        "--dir",
791	        distrib.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
792	        "--out",
793	        sums.to_str().expect("utf8 path"),
794	    ]);
795	
796	    let raw = fs::read_to_string(&sums).expect("sums");
797	    assert_eq!(raw.lines().count(), 1, "{raw}");
798	    let line = raw.lines().next().expect("entry");
799	    assert!(
800	        line.ends_with("  deadreckon-installer.sh"),
801	        "entry must be a flat basename: {line}"
802	    );
803	    assert!(
804	        !line.contains('/'),
805	        "no path segments in SHA256SUMS: {line}"
806	    );
807	}

**Phase 2 — Tracing the new tar args:**

`entries` comes from `fs.readdirSync(sourceDir)` where `sourceDir = extractDir` — the extraction of an archive produced by an earlier CI build step (cargo-dist output). These are positional args to GNU/BSD tar with no `--` end-of-options separator. A top-level archive member whose name begins with `-` would be parsed as an option flag by tar — e.g., `--checkpoint-action=exec=<cmd>` triggers arbitrary command execution. This pipeline runs with Apple Developer ID signing credentials and notarization tokens in env, so RCE here is privileged.

This is the exact "UNDER-VALIDATED SINK ARG" pattern: previously the code passed the literal `"."`, which is uninfluenceable. The `+` lines replace it with filenames discovered at runtime, removing the implicit safety.

**Phase 2c checks:**
- SENSITIVE-TO-OBSERVABILITY: error messages (`tar -tf failed for ${name}: ${listing.stderr}`) include only the artifact name (already a public asset name) and tar's stderr — no secrets reachable.
- CONTROL REGRESSION: no fail-closed validator removed; the diff actually ADDS a fail-closed `assertInstallableArchiveLayout` check.
- SECURITY-REGISTRY FANOUT: the new `.includes("/trust/")` and `"/SHA256SUMS"` branches in `artifactKind` widen classification but don't gate security decisions.
- PATH TRAVERSAL via manifest name: the old code did `path.join(dir, name)` with `name` from the manifest (attacker-controlled if manifest is replaced) — could escape `dir`. **Sibling sink check:** the same script extracts with `tar -xJf archive -C destination` and `tar -xzf archive -C destination`. The archive path comes from `findArchives()` which filters by extension and target triple, then sorts — paths originate from filesystem walk in CI workspace, but if a malicious archive path with leading `-` ever reached it, the same option-injection class would apply. Pre-existing; not introduced by this diff. The repack site IS introduced by this diff.

**Fix:** insert `"--"` before the entries spread.

**Tar option-injection regression in `sign-macos-artifacts.mjs` repackArchive** — the diff replaces the safe literal `"."` with `...entries` (filenames from `fs.readdirSync(sourceDir)`) but doesn't insert a `--` end-of-options separator. Any extracted top-level filename starting with `-` becomes a tar option (e.g., `--checkpoint-action=exec=...`, `--use-compress-program=...`, `--to-command=...`), each of which yields arbitrary command execution. This pipeline runs only in the official-release macOS signing job with APPLE_CERT_P12/APPLE_CERT_PWD/APPLE_ID/APPLE_TEAM_ID/APPLE_APP_PWD in env, so the impact is exfiltration of Apple Developer ID signing material. Trivial fix: insert `"--"` before the spread.

Notes on what I checked and ruled out:
- `assertInstallableArchiveLayout` uses `spawnSync("tar", [...])` array-form on a path derived from filesystem walk → no shell-injection surface, and fails closed on errors.
- The verify-manifest rewrite using `relativeByName` actually closes a pre-existing path-traversal surface (manifest-supplied `name` no longer flows into `path.join(dir, name)` unfiltered).
- `releaseFiles` collapse-by-basename fails closed on conflicting content (`throw new Error("conflicting contents...")`) and the same dedup is used for manifest creation and verification, so they remain in lockstep.
